'''Kifune Shrine''' (貴船神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Hida, Gifu|ar|هيدا غيفو|az|Hida (şəhər)|azb|هیدا، قیفو|ce|Хида|ceb|Hida (lungsod sa Hapon, Gifu-ken)|cs|Hida (Gifu)|de|Hida|eo|Hida (Japanio)|es|Hida (Gifu)|fa|هیدا، گیفو|fi|Hida (Gifu)|fr|Hida (Gifu)|it|Hida|ja|飛騨市|ko|히다시|mzn|هیدا، گیفو|nl|Hida (Gifu)|pl|Hida (Gifu)|pt|Hida (Gifu)|ro|Hida|ru|Хида|su|Hida, Gifu|sv|Hida|tg|Ҳида|th|ฮิดะ|tl|Hida, Gifu|tr|Hida, Gifu|tt|Хида|uk|Хіда (Ґіфу)|ur|ہڈا، گیفو|vi|Hida, Gifu|war|Hida, Gifu|zh|飛驒市|zh_classical|飛驒市|zh_min_nan|Hida-chhī|zh_yue|飛驒|qid=Q847319|lt=Hida, Gifu}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|en|Gifu Prefecture|qid=Q131277|lt=Gifu Prefecture}}.

It is considered a possible location (論社) for {{ill|Takata Shrine|ja|高田神社|qid=Q124481862}}, an {{ill|Enshrinement in the Engishiki|ja|延喜式神名帳}}-listed shrine of {{ill|Yoshiki District, Gifu|ja|吉城郡|zh|吉城郡|qid=Q8056123}}, Hida Province. Another contender for this title is {{ill|Takata Shrine (Hida)|ja|高田神社 (飛騨市)|qid=Q11672195}}.

== History ==

The exact date of Kifune Shrine’s founding is unknown. From the {{ill|Muromachi period|en|Muromachi period|qid=Q334845|lt=Muromachi period}} onward, the shrine known as Takada Shrine declined, and its precise location was lost.

During the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|qid=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, a debate arose over whether the historic Takada Shrine was actually Kifune Shrine in Koreju, Furukawa-go, or the Hakusan Shrine in Oe, Furukawa-go. The correct reading of the name 高田神社 should be "Agata Shrine" (あがたじんじゃ), but it was mistakenly read as "Takada Shrine" (たかだじんじゃ). Supporters of Kifune Shrine pointed to the local place name "Takada" (字高田) as evidence that it had been a sacred site, arguing that this indicated Kifune Shrine was the true Takada Shrine.

This debate was settled in the {{ill|Bunka|ca|Bunka|de|Bunka (Ära)|es|Bunka|fa|بونکا|fr|Ère Bunka|ia|Bunka|ja|文化 (元号)|ko|분카|ms|Zaman Bunka|ru|Бунка|simple|Bunka|sr|Бунка|sv|Bunka|tr|Bunka|zh|文化 (年號)|qid=Q1373146|lt=Bunka era}} when the {{ill|Yoshida family (Shinto)|fr|Clan Yoshida|ja|吉田家|ko|요시다가|simple|Yoshida family|qid=Q11413722|lt=Yoshida family}}, a prominent Shinto priestly family, identified Hakusan Shrine in Oe as the true site of Takada Shrine. The shrine was accordingly renamed Takada Shrine. However, Kifune Shrine's claim remained strong, and in {{ill|1869|en|1869|qid=Q7720|lt=Meiji 2}} (1869), an investigation by Takayama Prefecture found the location of Takada Shrine to be "unverified." It was not until {{ill|1870|ab|1870|af|1870|als|1870|am|1870 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1870|ar|1870|ary|1870|arz|1870|ast|1870|av|1870 сон|avk|1870|az|1870|azb|۱۸۷۰ (میلادی)|ba|1870 йыл|ban|1870|bar|1870|bat_smg|1870|bcl|1870|be|1870|be_x_old|1870|bg|1870|bn|১৮৭০|bpy|মারি ১৮৭০|br|1870|bs|1870.|ca|1870|cdo|1870 nièng|ce|1870 шо|ceb|1870|ckb|١٨٧٠|crh|1870|cs|1870|csb|1870|cv|1870|cy|1870|da|1870|de|1870|diq|1870|el|1870|eml|1870|eo|1870|es|1870|et|1870|eu|1870|fa|۱۸۷۰|fi|1870|fiu_vro|1870|fo|1870|fr|1870|frp|1870|frr|1870|fur|1870|fy|1870|ga|1870|gan|1870年|gcr|1870|gd|1870|gl|1870|gn|1870|gv|1870|hak|1870-ngièn|he|1870|hi|१८७०|hif|1870|hr|1870.|hsb|1870|ht|1870 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1870|hy|1870|hyw|1870 թուական|ia|1870|id|1870|ilo|1870|io|1870|is|1870|it|1870|ja|1870年|jbo|1870moi|jv|1870|ka|1870|kaa|1870|kk|1870 жыл|kn|೧೮೭೦|ko|1870년|krc|1870 джыл|ku|1870|kv|1870-ӧд во|kw|1870|la|1870|lb|1870|lez|1870 йис|li|1870|lij|1870|lmo|1870|lt|1870 m.|lv|1870. gads|mai|१८७०|map_bms|1870|mdf|1870|mg|1870|mhr|1870|mi|1870|min|1870|mk|1870|mr|इ.स. १८७०|mrj|1870 и|ms|1870|my|၁၈၇၀|myv|1870 ие|mzn|۱۸۷۰|nah|1870|nap|1870|nds|1870|nds_nl|1870|nl|1870|nn|1870|no|1870|nrm|1870|nso|1870|oc|1870|olo|1870|or|୧୮୭୦|os|1870-æм аз|pa|1870|pl|1870|pnb|1870|pt|1870|qu|1870|ro|1870|ru|1870 год|rue|1870|sa|१८७०|sah|1870|scn|1870|sd|1870ع|se|1870|sh|1870.|shn|1870|si|1870|simple|1870|sk|1870|sl|1870|smn|1870|sq|1870|sr|1870|stq|1870|su|1870|sv|1870|sw|1870|szl|1870|ta|1870|te|1870|tet|1870|tg|Соли 1870|th|พ.ศ. 2413|tk|1870|tl|1870|tly|1870|tr|1870|tt|1870 ел|udm|1870 ар|uk|1870|ur|1870ء|uz|1870|vec|1870|vi|1870|vls|1870|vo|1870|wa|1870|war|1870|wuu|1870年|xmf|1870|yi|1870|za|1870 nienz|zea|1870|zh|1870年|zh_classical|一八七〇年|zh_min_nan|1870 nî|zh_yue|1870年|qid=Q7741|lt=Meiji 3}} (1870) that the Hakusan Shrine was officially recognized as the true Takada Shrine.

Although Kifune Shrine was not renamed Takada Shrine, it remains recognized as a possible location (論社) for the historical Takada Shrine.
